scope: Origin accounting for the retained fixed-base house only. Inner-wall classification names all inner crossings collectively, never one corner splice. The ground-core gravity budget is uniform over the source grid-top to first-floor soffit interval. Weather leaves have separate moisture and support paths. Mixed reserves retain unresolved crossing ownership.

rules.family: RC edge beyond previously counted RC and upper core
rules.reason: Added first-floor edge concrete carried through upper wall and floor receivers.
Grid, caps and low ties terminate at or below the source grid top beneath the wall DPC.
Standing plant is routed directly to the suspended ground slab/grid, below the wall DPC.

rules.family: court lower tie, blind block and terminal steel
rules.reason: The combined steel allowance has no separated stock extent or declared crossing ownership.
Reinforcement at the first-floor edge; no favourable minimum mass credit.
Exterior deck load goes directly to the court ground girders.
Exterior loggia deck is carried by the two low ties below the wall DPC.
Passage deck goes to its separate ground beams.
First-floor bridge above the cut; crossing distribution still belongs to the structural model.
First-floor gravity fields above the cut.
First-floor reinforcement above the cut.
Residual first-floor material and occupancy above the cut.

rules.family: floor positive ties and plate reserve
rules.reason: Whole tie/foot/end/plate reserve lacks separated elevations and crossing identities.
Ground slab interval is Z−380 to −180, below the wall DPC.
The source gross uniform 3350 mm core/finish gravity budget spans grid top to first-floor soffit; split by the declared cut, without assigning all of it to corner piers.
Finish and use loads act on the ground slab and bypass the wall DPC irrespective of their application height.

rules.family: ground floor full two-face cage reserve
rules.reason: Ground slab cage shares the below-cut slab path.
Weather leaf is supported on its own masonry/moisture path; not assigned to the inner structural plate.
Upper ceiling above the cut.
Combined midlanding beam and ground-to-landing post includes an unsplit below-cut post fraction.

rules.family: outer pier cage and positive DPC stock reserve
rules.reason: 420 kg cage and 120 kg joint stock are aggregated without source-separated vertical extents.
Declared retained first-floor edge material, used only in its retained suction combination.
Declared retained ring steel above the cut.
Declared retained roof steel above the cut.
Declared upper core mass above the cut.

rules.family: roof plane reserve at distributed interface stations
rules.reason: Roof bracing reserve above the cut, retaining actual distributed interface ownership.
Roof gravity, occupancy and signed suction originate above the cut.
Midlanding load above the cut.
Steel wall-head ring above the cut.
The source splits between upper landing and ground/stair-header receivers; cut crossing of the lower route is not declared.
Upper-storey core and finish above the cut.
Upper structural downstands above the cut.
Upper weather leaf follows its own support and DPC route, not the inner structural plate.
Five-kN station challenges have no declared elevation or DPC crossing identity.
